{{Nihongo|'''Kenkichi Sonogashira'''|薗頭 健吉|Sonogashira Kenkichi|born 25 October 1931}} is a Japanese [[chemist]] and was a professor of chemistry at [[Osaka University]] in Japan. He discovered the [[Sonogashira coupling]] in 1975. Sonogashira was later a professor at [[Osaka City University]] and retired in 2004.
